title: The War in Heaven
place: First Sanctuary · Threshold of the Breach
body: There was war in the sky. Michael and his angels made war on the dragon. The dragon and his angels made war.
note: World English Bible (public domain), Revelation 12:7, quoted word for word. The player angel, bracer, sanctuary, adversaries, protective ward and battle objective are original game fiction inspired by this vision. Scripture does not specify Michael’s armour or wing count.
